source_title: Tiger terrorising villagers along TATR buffer captured - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Chandrapur: Bringing relief to residents of villages in Chimur taluka, the forest department on Friday successfully captured a tiger that had triggered fear in the Palasgaon forest range of the Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve (TATR) buffer zone.The tiger, identified as T-179 (SM-1), was captured in compartment No. 558 of the Palasgaon forest range on Oct 30, following permission from the principal chief conservator of forests (Wildlife). A team led by head veterinary doctor of the Transit Treatment Centre, Chandrapur, Dr Kundan Poschalwar carried out the tranquilisation and capture operation.The tiger was shifted to the TTC in Chandrapur for further medical examination, treatment and necessary procedures.The animal had recently attacked and killed Usha Gurunule, a resident of the Palasgaon area, triggering panic among villagers.
